howard.title: HOWARD
howard.blurb: cheerful clever 7-year-old Hong Kong primary-school boy, chibi (~3 heads). Messy fluffy brown hair with spiky tufts, big brown eyes, confident grin. White polo with blue-and-yellow trimmed collar and school badge, navy shorts, white socks, blue-and-white sneakers, black wristbands, navy backpack with yellow accents.

chiihoward.title: CHIIHOWARD
chiihoward.blurb: same cheerful 7yo boy as Howard (same face, messy brown hair peeking out) but casual: white knit beanie with two round bear ears (pink inner ears), soft pink T-shirt with tiny cute Chiikawa face print, light-blue shorts, white wristbands, white socks, pink-trimmed sneakers. NO backpack, NO school uniform.

hornam.title: HOR NAM
hornam.blurb: always-angry 7yo HK schoolboy, chibi. Short black spiky hair, flushed red cheeks, angry reddish eyes with furrowed brows, gritted teeth, small red anger-vein. White polo blue-yellow trim + school badge, navy shorts, white socks, red-and-white sneakers, black wristbands, dark-red backpack. Fists slightly clenched.

percy.title: PERCY
percy.blurb: Howard's TALL friendly classmate, 7yo, noticeably taller (~4 heads, long legs). Neat short side-parted brown hair, warm brown eyes, friendly smile. White polo blue-yellow trim + school badge, navy shorts, white socks, blue-and-white sneakers, black wristbands, navy backpack yellow accents. Draw ONLY Percy, NOT a bear.

tyrus.title: TYRUS
tyrus.blurb: sporty 7yo tennis kid, chibi (~3.5 heads), athletic. Messy brown hair with red sweatband, bright brown eyes, eager grin. Teal sports jersey white V-neck white side stripes white number 1, white tennis shorts, red wristbands, white socks, teal-and-white sneakers. Holds red tennis racket in right hand.

daddy.title: DADDY
daddy.blurb: Howard's jolly food-loving VERY ROUND dad, chibi (~3 heads, extremely chubby). Short dark hair, round glasses, thick moustache, double chin, big happy smile. Bright orange T-shirt stretched over HUGE round belly (belly button peeking), khaki shorts, bare legs, brown sandals, little sauce stain. Hands empty.
